description: This file defines API routes for CRUD operations on notes in a Node.js Express application. It sets up endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, and links these endpoints to a notesController.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all notes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note by ID.
